visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large, vibrant green shopping bag with the text "BOTTEGA VENETA" prominently displayed upside down fills most of the frame. A young man with neatly styled dark hair and a white knit sweater pops up from behind the bag, smiling brightly into the lens. (2) The man leans over the green bag, resting his chin on his crossed arms in a playful pose. He is positioned in a brightly lit room with soft white vertical curtains and dark wood flooring, creating a clean and modern aesthetic. (3) He reaches into the oversized green bag and carefully pulls out a large, cream-colored fabric dust bag. His hand movements are deliberate and steady as he shows the size of the inner package to the camera, maintaining a joyful facial expression. (4) The main product, a large black leather tote bag called the "Large Zipped Cabat," is revealed. It features intricate woven leather detailing on the sides. He holds it up with both hands to showcase its substantial size, slouchy structure, and premium leather grain. (5) The man opens the top zipper to display the interior, revealing a dark green suede lining and internal storage compartments. He uses his fingers to point out the stitching and the functional layout of the bag's inside while looking back at the camera. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the bottom edge of the bag where a small, subtle brand logo is embossed into the black leather. He handles the bag carefully, turning it slowly to let the studio light catch the texture of the taurillon leather. (7) Sitting cross-legged on the dark floor, the man poses with the bag resting against his shoulder. He looks directly at the camera with a satisfied and confident smile, wearing white socks, concluding the showcase in the modern setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A youthful male voice speaks enthusiastically with high pitch variability over a steady, upbeat electronic BGM featuring a clear four-on-the-floor kick drum and bright synthesizer pads. The acoustics suggest a controlled indoor environment with professional clarity and minimal room reverb. (2) Loud, crinkling rustling sounds of a heavy paper shopping bag are clearly heard as the speaker physically moves the object. The vocal delivery remains friendly and fast-paced, describing the opening of a package with high emotional energy and clear articulation. (3) The acoustic texture shifts with a softer, muffled rustling sound of fabric as a dust bag is extracted from the paper. The BGM remains at a consistent volume, mixed perfectly beneath the narration about the product's premium quality and origin. (4) Frictional sounds of high-quality leather rubbing against itself are audible as the main bag is handled. The speaker's voice adopts a more descriptive tone with moderate intensity, focusing on material characteristics like the taurillon leather while the music continues. (5) A sharp, metallic zipping sound cuts through the mix, followed by the speaker's voice echoing slightly as he discusses the interior compartments. The BGM maintains its rhythmic pulse, ensuring a positive and energetic atmosphere throughout the technical description. (6) The narration becomes slightly more intimate and quiet as the speaker emphasizes the subtle branding. Subdued handling noises persist in the recording, and the video concludes with the BGM sustaining until a final hard cut as the positive remark ends.
